title: Act No. 1 of 2021 – General Revenue Supplementary Appropriation No. 5Act, 2021
text:
No. 1] Supplementary Appropriation (2020/2021) (No. 5) 1
No. 1 of 2021
I assent,
(SIR COLVILLE N. YOUNG)
Governor-General
19th January, 2021
AN ACT to appropriate further sums of money for the
use of the Public Service of Belize for the financial
year ending on the thirty-first day of March, two
thousand and twenty-one.
(Gazetted 23rd January, 2021).
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and the Senate of Belize
and by the authority of the same, as follows:-
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
GENERAL REVENUE SUPPLEMENTARY
APPROPRIATION (2020/2021) (No. 5) ACT, 2021.

2 Supplementary Appropriation (2020/2021) (No. 5) [No. 1
Appropriation 2. The sums of money appearing in the Schedule hereto are
of sums of
hereby declared to be payable for the financial year ending
money in the
Schedule. on the thirty-first day of March, two thousand and twenty
one, for and in respect of the services mentioned in the said
Schedule in addition to the sums appropriated by the General
Act No. 9/2020
13/2020 Revenue Appropriation (2020/2021) Act, 2020.
